title: AI Coding Dictionary: AI coding jargon, explained in plain English
description:
Matt Pocock is leading the crusade against messy vibe coding. dictionary-of-ai-coding is his newest drop. Looks like a comprehensive open-source glossary of modern AI concepts. Tracer Bullets, Evals, Agentic Harnesses. But it's formatted as an agent-native reference module injected directly into your LLM's context. Grounds your agent in strict industry-standard definitions instead of hallucinated interpretations.

https://github.com/mattpocock/dictionary-of-ai-coding

#github #opensource
